resources.string: This is Spotify\'s own login page. FXM never sees your password: it keeps only the login Spotify gives this window, encrypted on this phone, and uses it only to get Spotify login tokens. Google and Facebook don\'t allow signing in here. Getting a code from another app? Come back through the recent apps screen: FXM\'s icon and its notification close this window.
Use Google or Facebook for Spotify? Set a Spotify password first
%1$s doesn\'t allow signing in inside apps. Log in with the email address of your Spotify account and a Spotify password instead. If your account has no password yet, set one first.
This window opens only Spotify\'s login pages.
FXM couldn\'t reach Spotify\'s login page. Check your connection, then close this window and try again.
